mapper.select:
select COUNT(*) AS sku_total, SUM( ROUND( COALESCE(asa.total_stock, 0) + COALESCE(asa.local_in_transit_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_semi_inventory_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_auto_inventory_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_transit_quantity, 0), 2 ) ) AS total_warehouse, -- 计算滞销商品个数 SUM( ROUND( (COALESCE(asa.total_stock, 0) + COALESCE(asa.local_in_transit_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_semi_inventory_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_auto_inventory_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pwts.bc_transit_quantity, 0)) * COALESCE(asa.warehouse_cost, 0), 2 ) ) AS total_warehouse_cost -- 计算总仓库成本
from aliexpress_sku_analysis as asa LEFT JOIN pofit_warehouse_total_statistics pwts ON asa.sku=pwts.sku
DATE(created_at) = ( SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) FROM aliexpress_sku_analysis ) AND status='正常销售' AND sales_last28_days = 0 AND ( pwts.bc_semi_inventory_quantity != 0 OR pwts.bc_auto_inventory_quantity != 0 OR total_stock != 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aliexpress_mabang_order_list aml WHERE aml.sku = asa.sku AND aml.payment_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 48 DAY ) AND sku_create_time <= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
and asa.sku like concat('%', #{sku}, '%')
and asa.total_warehouse_cost > #{totalWarehouseCost}
